evidence.title: Navigate from an authorized Case Timeline row to its separately reauthorized local source preview
evidence.goal: Complete the canonical Class-0 Timeline open-source transition for the existing runnable Incident→Case Timeline loopback browser by routing the pre-existing owner-checked synthetic source preview. Display links only for explicit trusted host opt-in, preserve source ACL and original browser history; no new owner, source engine or persistence.
outputs: Runnable Case Timeline HTML links to existing /demo-source-open only on explicitly opted-in loopback host, by Case/Entry ID
Source-open request rechecks all permissions server side and exposes bounded existing synthetic preview JSON; browser Back preserves previous Case filters/page
No new source permission engine, third-party dependency, token, redirect, data storage or production claim
acceptance_tests: Real localhost HTTP from Command Incident to Case Timeline HTML shows source open link for visible authorized Event
Following fixed link to existing source owner JSON returns exactly the independently allowed preview, source kind and object identity
Direct source URL without bearer/with commander bearer/foreign Case/Entry returns denied without preview or source ID
Generic unopted Case Timeline HTML and legacy JSON do not expose the local demo link
XSS hostile IDs URL-escaped and never interpreted as HTML or extra query authority; browser back uses existing previously-filtered Case link
Linux/macOS/Windows CI, Go tests race/vet, security kernel all success on exact SHA before review

rules: Strict tenant isolation and permission checking
